blocks.title: What this screen will not tell you

fields.v: no carrier eta exists on any shipment
quote and order lines are not absorbed yet

blocks.note: Both are named in writing on the plan. A silent field beats an invented one.

key.d: Read from the records this morning rather than carried over from a report somebody ran once.
Stalled work is counted, not discovered. Four short questions every fourteen days, and every answer writes a record.
Each row says why it surfaced, so the first question of the day is already answered.

key.t: The honest gaps, on the screen
key.d: Zero of the recorded shipments carry a carrier eta, so the platform says nothing rather than guessing a date.
Revenue, insights and commissions read the rows the team already works in. No second system to reconcile.

fields.v: on, routed to a parallel empty database

blocks.note: This is how the software gets shown to a prospect. It is not a test environment, and nothing written here reaches production.

fields.v: copy, rotate the password, or switch it off

key.t: A new hire is a row
key.d: The staff roster lives in the database, so adding somebody is no longer a deployment.
Suspend, reinstate, force a logout, reset a second factor. Separate paths, so a password reset never wipes two factor.
Demo mode routes the browser at an empty parallel database. Every screenshot in this tour comes from there.
Per client, set or rotate the password, copy the link, or turn the door off entirely.
